title: 10 C.N.C. § 10-101.10 — Invested Funds
text:
INVESTED FUNDS.

Funds from tribal operations may be invested by the Governor or his delegate in accordance
with applicable sections of this Title. Tribal Funds invested pursuant to this Section shall be for a
period deemed appropriate by the Governor, insofar as such time does not affect the cash needs of

Finance and Taxation

a program, a department or a business. Invested Funds are exempt from the requirements of Section
10-101.7. (PR22-019, 7/28/05; PR29-006, 8/17/12; PR33-001, 12/18/15)
